**Paris Get‑away: A 7‑Day Adventure** > *“Paris is always a good idea.” – Audrey Hepburn* > *Travel time: 7 days (including travel)* --- ## 1️⃣ Quick Overview | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Best Time to Visit** | May–June or September–October (mild weather, fewer crowds) | | **Duration** | 7 days (including 2 travel days) | | **Budget** | €1,200–€1,800 per person (mid‑range) | | **Currency** | Euro (€) | | **Language** | French (English widely spoken in tourist areas) | | **Transport** | Airfare + public transit (Metro, RER, buses) + occasional taxis | --- ## 2️⃣ Flights & Arrival | Step | What to Do | |------|------------| | **Book Flights** | Look for direct flights from major hubs (NYC, London, Frankfurt). Use fare alerts on Skyscanner or Google Flights. | | **Arrival Airport** | Charles de Gaulle (CDG) or Orly (ORY). | | **Airport Transfer** | • **RER B** (direct to city center) – €10.30 one‑way.
• **Roissybus** (to Opéra) – €12.90.
• **Taxi** – €50–€60 (flat rate). | | **Check‑in** | Arrive at the hotel by 3 pm. Most hotels offer free Wi‑Fi and a small welcome drink. | --- ## 3️⃣ Accommodation | Option | Price Range | Highlights | |--------|-------------|------------| | **Mid‑Range Boutique** | €120–€180/night | Hotel Le Six (Latin Quarter), Hôtel Henriette (Marais) | | **Luxury** | €250–€350/night | Hôtel Plaza Athénée (Eiffel Tower view), Four Seasons George V | | **Budget** | €70–€100/night | Generator Paris (Le Marais), Hotel ibis Paris Montmartre (Montmartre) | | **Airbnb** | €80–€150/night | Studio in Saint‑Germain, 1‑bedroom in Canal Saint‑Martin | **Tip:** Book a place with a kitchenette if you want to save on meals. --- ## 4️⃣ Daily Itinerary > *Feel free to swap days or skip activities that don’t interest you.* ### Day 1 – Arrival & Settling In - **Afternoon:** Check into hotel, freshen up. - **Evening:** Stroll along the Seine, grab a croissant & café at **Café de Flore** (Saint‑Germain). - **Dinner:** **Le Coupe Chou** – classic French bistro. ### Day 2 – Classic Landmarks - **Morning:** Eiffel Tower (book tickets online; 9 am slot recommended). - **Lunch:** Picnic at Champ de Mars (buy baguette, cheese, wine). - **Afternoon:** Arc de Triomphe & Champs‑Élysées walk. - **Evening:** Seine river cruise (Bateaux Mouches) – sunset view. ### Day 3 – Art & Culture - **Morning:** Louvre Museum (early entry, 9 am). - **Lunch:** Café Marly (inside Louvre). - **Afternoon:** Palais Royal & gardens. - **Evening:** Opera Garnier tour (if available). ### Day 4 – Montmartre & Sacré‑Coeur - **Morning:** Sacré‑Coeur Basilica (stunning city view). - **Lunch:** **Le Consulat** (historic café). - **Afternoon:** Explore artists’ square, Place du Tertre. - **Evening:** Moulin Rouge show (reserve 2–3 weeks ahead). ### Day 5 – Day Trip to Versailles - **All Day:** Palace of Versailles (tickets include gardens). - **Lunch:** **La Petite Venise** inside the palace grounds. - **Return:** Evening metro back to Paris. ### Day 6 – Modern & Shopping - **Morning:** Centre Pompidou (modern art). - **Lunch:** **Le Georges** (Panorama). - **Afternoon:** Le Marais shopping – concept stores, vintage boutiques. - **Evening:** Dinner at **L'As du Fallafel** (famous falafel spot). ### Day 7 – Relax & Departure - **Morning:** Jardin du Luxembourg stroll. - **Brunch:** **Café Lomi** (great coffee). - **Afternoon:** Last‑minute souvenir shopping. - **Departure:** Head to airport via RER B or taxi. --- ## 5️⃣ Transportation Inside Paris | Mode | Cost | Notes | |------|------|-------| | **Metro** | €1.90 per ride (single ticket) | Unlimited 24‑hour pass: €14.90 | | **RER** | €2.40–€5.00 (depending on zone) | Use for airport, Versailles, Disneyland | | **Bus** | €1.90 per ride | Same pass as Metro | | **Bike Share (Vélib')** | €1.75 per 30 min | Great for short trips | | **Taxi** | €50–€60 from CDG | Flat rate; use official taxi app | | **Uber** | €35–€45 from CDG | Usually cheaper than taxi | **Recommendation:** Buy a **Paris Visite** pass (zones 1‑3) for €20.90 (24 h) or €27.80 (48 h). Unlimited rides on Metro, RER, bus, tram. --- ## 6️⃣ Dining Highlights | Dish | Where | |------|-------| | Croissants & Pain au Chocolat | **Du Pain et des Idées** (Belleville) | | Escargot | **L’Arpège** (3 Michelin stars) | | Coq au Vin | **Le Relais de l’Entrecôte** (multiple locations) | | Macarons | **Ladurée** (Place de la Concorde) | | Cheese & Wine | **Fromagerie Barthélemy** (Saint‑Germain) | | Street Food | **Street Food Paris** (Various locations) | **Tip:** Try a “menu du jour” (prix fixe) for a full French experience at a reasonable price. --- ## 7️⃣ Budget Breakdown (per person) | Category | Approx. Cost | |----------|--------------| | Flights | €400–€600 | | Accommodation | €840–€1,260 | | Food & Drink | €280–€420 | | Attractions & Tours | €120–€200 | | Transport (metro, RER, taxi) | €80–€120 | | Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | €100–€150 | | **Total** | **€1,720–€2,650** | *(Adjust based on your choices: luxury vs budget, dining preferences.)* --- ## 8️⃣ Packing Checklist | Item | Why | |------|-----| | Comfortable walking shoes | Paris streets are cobblestone | | Light jacket & umbrella | Weather can be unpredictable | | Power adapter (Type C/F) | European sockets | | Reusable water bottle | Stay hydrated | | Small daypack | Carry essentials while exploring | | Travel insurance | Health & travel coverage | | Copies of passport & reservations | Safety & backup | --- ## 9️⃣ Tips & Tricks 1. **Book tickets online** for major attractions to avoid long queues. 2. **Use the Metro during off‑peak hours** (before 9 am & after 7 pm) for quieter rides. 3. **Learn basic French phrases** – locals appreciate the effort. 4. **Avoid tourist traps** – ask locals for restaurant recommendations. 5. **Stay hydrated** – tap water is safe and free. 6. **Keep an eye on your belongings** – pickpocketing can happen in crowded areas. 7. **Try local markets** – Marché d’Aligre, Marché des Enfants Rouges for fresh food. --- ## 10️⃣ Final Thought Paris is a city that blends history, art, cuisine, and romance. With this itinerary, you’ll experience its iconic landmarks, hidden gems, and culinary delights—all while staying within a comfortable budget. Bon voyage! 🚀✈️🇫🇷
